payload.summary: Burn ritual reworked per the planning partner design. Main card anchored at 25% of the felt and vertically centred via a zero-size .burn-stage anchor plus margin-centred children; the 1.25 oversize moved off the burn-expose keyframe onto .burn-card-slot so entry motion and persistent size stop fighting. Burned cards now a left-anchored grid beside the card (max 5 columns, rows=ceil(n/5), short final row centred on a half column), mini cards at half the card tokens, grid midline pinned to the card midline. New burn-place entry (CSS-staggered via --anim-burn-stagger) and burn-gather exit that collapses every card onto cell 0 in reverse order, plus a radial scrim. Duplicate shoe-row readout write dropped (callout + aria-live announce remain, callout aria-hidden); .burn-readout div kept as the shoe row grid spacer. Pure burnGridLayout/burnWaitSchedule/burnRitualBudget extracted and unit tested for counts 1-10 plus a 3000ms felt-lock budget read from anim.css. Verified live at seeds s2 (10 cards), s12 (7, short row centred), s4 (1) at 1280, 1100 and 880 viewports: card centre lands exactly on the 25%/50% crosshair, grid centre matches card centre, no clipping. 69 tests pass, tsc clean.
